1. Objective: Retrieve all approved drugs indicated for chronic kidney disease, returning their identifiers, names, structures, and indication details.
2. Output: chembl_id, pref_name, canonical_smiles, indication_curie (EFO ID), indication_label (EFO term), max_phase_for_ind.
3. Source: molecule_dictionary, drug_indication, compound_structures.
4. Logic: Join molecule_dictionary to drug_indication on molregno. Join compound_structures on molregno to retrieve canonical SMILES. Filter drug_indication where mesh_heading equals 'chronic kidney disease' (case-insensitive) or efo_term matches the condition. Filter molecule_dictionary where max_phase equals 4 (approved). Sort by chembl_id.
